rules.description: Verify all active StatVars meet scoped freshness boundaries (>= 2022 for 2022 population projections, >= 2007 for 2007 census breakdowns, and >= 2011 for 2011-2014 demographics, DHS, and annual population series).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Female', 'Count_Person_Male') AND CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2022' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2022' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_(Rural|Urban)_(Female|Male)$') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2007' ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2011' END AND total_svs > 0
